user.title: Set up Alexa Announcement Builder
user.description: Create the integration entry to enable the Alexa Announcement Builder action. No account credentials or device selection are required.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Alexa Announcement Builder is already configured.

send.name: Send Alexa announcement
send.description: Build an ordered Alexa SSML sequence and send it through one or more notify entities.

target.name: Targets
target.description: Alexa Devices Speak or Announce notify entities. A sequence containing Sound requires all selected entities to be Speak targets.

adjust_volume.name: Temporarily adjust device volume
adjust_volume.description: Set each selected Echo to the announcement volume, then restore each device's previous volume.

announcement_volume.name: Announcement volume
announcement_volume.description: Device volume used while speaking or announcing. Applies only when temporary volume adjustment is enabled.

restore_after.name: Restore volume after
restore_after.description: Seconds to wait after a successful send before restoring each device's previous volume.

sequence.name: Sequence
sequence.description: Each item requires a Content type and its matching field. Other fields are ignored. Drag items to set playback order. Maximum five audio clips.

break_before_ms.name: Break before
break_before_ms.description: Silent break before the complete sequence, in milliseconds.

break_after_ms.name: Break after
break_after_ms.description: Silent break after the complete sequence, in milliseconds.
